Pottker et al. [17] introduced detailed information on 2P50 as listed in Table 1. This dielectric fluid has a normal boiling point of about 49 °C, no flash point, a dielectric constant of about 1.75, and a dissipation factor of about 1 × 10-3 at frequencies up to 67 GHz, ensuring excellent dielectric properties and minimal signal loss. The environmental characteristics of Opteon™ 2P50 include a GWP of ~10 and negligible ozone depletion potential. The fluid also meets the requirements set by the Open Compute Project, including an autoignition temperature above 300 °C and a flash point greater than 155 °C (2P50 has no flash point according to ASTM D93). 5 Table 1.
